name: Adafenoxate
summary: Adafenoxate is a compound related to centrophenoxine, that has been found to act as a nootropic in rats.

pharmacology.text: Adafenoxate is a compound related to centrophenoxine, that has been found to act as a nootropic in rats.

uses.en: It is a research compound found to have nootropic effects in rats. It is not an approved medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，在大鼠身上顯示有促智作用，並非核准的藥品。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，在大鼠身上显示有促智作用，并非核准的药品。

fact.en: It is related to centrophenoxine, which was made in 1959 and combines DMAE with a plant growth hormone, 4-chlorophenoxyacetic acid.
fact.zh: 它與meclofenoxate（centrophenoxine）有關；後者於1959年合成，是把DMAE與一種植物生長素4-氯苯氧乙酸結合而成。
fact.zhHans: 它与meclofenoxate（centrophenoxine）有关；后者于1959年合成，是把DMAE与一种植物生长素4-氯苯氧乙酸结合而成。
